How much is a yacht charter on Koh Samui? | Our yachts start at 41,000 THB for a 3-hour sunset dinner cruise on the Red Baron junk (price for up to 20 guests), 50,000 THB for a 4-hour half day on the motor yacht Casablanca and 255,000 THB for an 8-hour day on the 61 ft Sunseeker Minor Affair. Prices are per charter and longer routes cost more.
How many guests can a yacht take on Koh Samui? | The Red Baron junk takes up to 70 guests plus crew; the motor yachts Casablanca and Minor Affair take up to 12 each. For groups of 13 to 45 who want a private boat, a catamaran is the better fit.
Is a chef or catering included on a Koh Samui yacht? | On Red Baron, meals and soft drinks are included. On Casablanca you can bring your own food and drinks, use the on-board BBQ or order a Thai food or barbecue package; on Minor Affair, lunch and wine are arranged in advance at extra cost. Tell us your plans and we quote the catering.
Can we see the White Lotus filming locations from the sea? | Yes: Season 3 was filmed largely at the Four Seasons Koh Samui on the north-west tip at Laem Yai, and a yacht day along the north and west coast passes its hillside villas. You see the resort from the water only; we don't land at private resorts.
Can we hire a yacht for a wedding or birthday on Koh Samui? | Yes. Red Baron takes up to 70 guests with meals included and suits weddings, big birthdays and company events; Casablanca and Minor Affair suit smaller celebrations and proposals. Give us at least a few days' notice for catering and decorations, more in high season.
How long is a yacht charter on Koh Samui? | Red Baron runs 3 hours (sunset dinner), 6 hours, 9 hours (around Samui or Koh Phangan) or 10 hours (Ang Thong). Casablanca runs 4-hour half days (10:00–14:00) or 8-hour full days (09:00–17:00), and every Minor Affair programme is 8 hours.
How far ahead should we book a yacht for Christmas and New Year? | As early as you can, ideally in November: yachts for 24–26 December, 30–31 December and 1 January are booked first. Night charters to watch the fireworks from the water are quoted case by case.
What happens to a yacht charter if the sea is rough? | The captain decides on the day. We first offer a sheltered route, such as the southern islands off the south-west coast; if the sea is unsafe we cancel, and you choose a full refund or a new date.
